name: Hands of the Animal
description: Faerie power (2 points, constant) letting an animal manipulate and carry an item as if it had human hands with Strength +5.

name: Hound
description: Faerie power letting a faerie know the direction and distance to its human quarry; Lamia's version detects unattended babies.

name: Illusionary Home
description: Faerie power using glamour to make a place look, sound, smell and feel like a suitable home for the faerie's role; used by the Ghula.

name: Image Phantom
description: Faerie power letting a non-principal faerie coat an object with illusion to seem another thing of similar size and shape, modelled on the spell of the same name.

name: Kiss of Forgetfulness
description: Faerie power causing the person touched to forget his mortal life until he sees an object associated with his home.

name: Kiss of Frost
description: Faerie power letting the person touched survive the cold above the snowline until he treads upon grass.

name: Kiss of the Mermaid
description: Faerie power letting the person kissed breathe under water until he walks upon dry land.

name: Loosely Material
description: Faerie power allowing a generally immaterial faerie to take on a material body of flesh, wood or elemental matter; also taken by Lamashtu and Mormo.

name: Pine Away
description: Faerie power causing the target to lose the will to live and vitality, treated as a major disease; glanconers use an Arcane Connection version.

name: Repel Animals
description: Faerie power working like Circle of Beast Warding.

name: Send Message
description: Faerie power to send short verbal messages to beings to which the faerie has Arcane Connections.

name: Spirit Away
description: Faerie power allowing the faerie to act as a threshold guardian.

name: Spreading a Mantle of Snow
description: Faerie power covering an area a mile across in snow, like Clouds of Summer Snow.

name: Steal Judgment
description: Faerie power making the target believe almost any lie the faerie tells by diminishing his capacity for doubt; possessed by glanconers.

name: Torrent from the Lungs
description: Faerie power, as Curse of the Desert, drawing water forth from the body for +15 damage.

name: Transform Victim into (Animal)
description: Faerie power turning a target who hears the faerie's voice into a land animal for Sun duration.

name: Transform Victim into (Bird or Fish)
description: Faerie power turning a target who hears the faerie's voice into a bird or fish.

name: Transform Victim into (Object or Plant)
description: Faerie power turning a target into a solid inanimate object or plant.

name: Powers of Transformation
description: Guidance on designing faerie transformation abilities as Greater Powers or Focus Powers.

name: Focus Powers
description: Broad faerie powers costing Might equal to the effect's magnitude, with Initiative of Quickness minus maximum magnitude; cannot be reduced by intricacy points.

name: Domestic Work
description: Focus power performing household tasks from a distance, including kindling fires and hurling objects.

name: Father of Serpents
description: Focus power duplicating non-Ritual Creo, Intellego, Muto or Rego spells pertaining to snakes.

name: Manifestation
description: Focus power manifesting the faerie's consciousness among animals and plants its glamour touches, controlling them.

name: Shrinking
description: Focus power letting a faerie reconfigure its body into any smaller Size.

name: Smithying
description: Focus power duplicating non-Ritual Creo, Muto, Rego or Perdo Terram spells, limited by motif.

name: Miser's Midas
description: Focus power turning any living thing the character touches, except himself, to stone.

name: Personal Powers
description: Faerie powers affecting only the faerie itself, often tailored using intricacy points.

name: Appear Human
description: Personal power allowing a humanoid faerie of size -2 to +2 to look and feel human via illusion; used by the Man in Black with a Sack on His Back.

name: Extended Glamour
description: Personal power granting awareness of everything within a domain; the faerie is coterminous with its landscape feature and extends an aura.

name: Flight
description: Personal power making the character capable of flight.

name: Immateriality
description: Personal power making a faerie immaterial until sunrise or nightfall.

name: Invisibility
description: Personal power, a personal version of Veil of Invisibility.

name: Shift Human Shapes
description: Personal power letting the character change its appearance to any other human configuration, but not replicate a specific person.

name: Silent Motion
description: Personal power allowing the character to move without noise.

name: Sight Beyond Sight
description: Personal power letting all five senses operate at a distance as far as the creature can see.

name: Size Reduction
description: Personal power letting the character take a single smaller Size.

name: Supernatural Agility
description: Personal power allowing minor supernatural feats with the Athletics Pretense.

name: Transform into Animal
description: Personal power transforming the character into a specified land animal; faeries retain speech.

name: Transform into Bird or Fish
description: Personal power transforming the character into a specified bird or fish.

name: Transform into Human
description: Power for non-human faeries to take human shape; the Ghula uses it to switch between human and feasting form.

name: Transform into (Solid Object)
description: Personal power transforming the character into a specified object capable of speech and limited movement.

name: Transform into (Environmental Effect)
description: Personal power transforming the character into a wave, breeze, cloud, fire or similar nebulous thing.

name: Fatal Menses
description: Lamashtu's constant poison power that poisons wells, kills crops and fetuses as she flies.

name: Enthralling Sound
description: Faerie power producing fear or infatuation through sound, used by Lamashtu, gorgons and the Lesser Nymph.

name: Enthrallment
description: Mentem faerie power possessed by Lamia.

name: Steal Eyes
description: Lamia's power to remove a victim's eyes and place them in her own head.

name: Squirming Sack
description: Power of the Man in Black moving a child who made eye contact into his sack.

name: Still Sack
description: Power of the Man in Black keeping children unconscious in his sack; a powerful version of Cause Drowsiness.

name: Immune to Bashing Weapons
description: Power of the scarecrow-bodied Man in Black making him undamaged by crushing weapons.

name: Cause Drowsiness
description: Faerie power causing sleep; used by the Ghula.

name: Deadly Gaze
description: Gorgon power transforming into stone any person or animal making eye contact.

name: Dozens of Eyes
description: Gorgon power of omnidirectional eyes granting extraordinary Perception.

name: Venomous Bite
description: Gorgon hair-snake power inflicting adder venom.

name: Possession
description: Mormo's power to possess a victim and control her.

name: Coils of the Entangling Plants
description: Lesser Nymph power as the spell of the same name.

name: Allure
description: Glanconer Mentem power.

name: Guide
description: Glanconer power working at Voice range on one who gave a love gift.

name: Intricacy Points
description: Points gained from spare spell levels used to reduce faerie power costs or improve Initiative.

name: Pretense
description: Faerie equivalent of Abilities, powered magic that copies human skills and grows by observing humans.

name: Player-Defined Pretenses
description: Pretenses corresponding to a faerie's story role rather than human abilities, negotiated with the troupe.

name: Chivalrous Combat
description: Example player-defined Pretense combining sword and lance use for a faerie knight.

name: Glamour
description: The faerie substance of identity and illusion that can be changed by creative humans.

name: Cognizance
description: A faerie's awareness of its role, determining its attitude to advancement (incognizant, narrowly or highly cognizant).

name: Vitality
description: Human life energy faeries harvest, stored as Pretense points to fuel advancement.

name: Creativity
description: Human creative collaboration required for a faerie to change its glamour and advance.

name: Encased Vis
description: Vis hoarded by faeries under a layer of glamour, used to aid advancement.

name: Sleeping Vis
description: Vis in which a faerie has left part of its glamour, allowing later reincorporation.

name: Faerie Advancement Through Change
description: Rules for faeries altering their roles to gain powers via cognizance, vitality and a creative human.

name: Faerie Speech
description: Faerie ability/Pretense allowing understanding of any language.

name: Faerie Sight
description: Faerie Virtue for perceiving the supernatural.

name: Touch of Faerie
description: Condition gained by children who survive being stolen or raised by faeries.

name: Silencing of the Oracles
description: A supernatural event that destroyed the capacity of faeries to predict the future, perhaps an act of God.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Flaw/concept whereby certain objects or images repel a faerie, e.g. Lamashtu and Pazuzu.

name: Sovereign Ward
description: Flaw by which a faerie is warded off by specific things such as folk charms or sunlight.

name: Restricted Might
description: Flaw limiting Might under conditions such as sunlight, firelight or winter.

name: Aegis of the Hearth
description: The ward defending a covenant, which some possessing faeries can pass if the host enters freely.

name: Parma Magica
description: Magi's magical protection, which does not resist Pretenses because they affect the faerie itself.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance against supernatural effects that faerie physical attacks must penetrate.

name: Faerie Might
description: Measure of a faerie's supernatural power.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Magical link used by faerie powers such as Send Message and the glanconer's Pine Away.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical substance found in faerie bodies and hoarded by faeries.

name: Gorgoneion
description: The head of the gorgon used as a traditional symbol warding off evil.

name: Life Stages
description: Human transitions (birth, reason, adulthood, mastery, mortality) that attract faeries.

name: Two Borders
description: Faeries that exist simultaneously on physical and developmental borders.

name: Tortoise Game
description: A children's game described by Errina based on a faerie that possesses mothers to kill babies.

name: Faerie Instructor
description: Minor Supernatural Virtue letting a faerie store human Abilities taken in bargains and give them to favored humans.

name: Faerie Trainer
description: Free Supernatural Virtue: the faerie has real human Abilities and can train humans conventionally.

name: Aloof
description: Minor General Flaw: the faerie finds humans uninteresting and rarely increases Pretenses.

name: Freshly Sprung
description: Minor Supernatural Flaw subtracting 50 experience points from Pretense pool.

name: Observant
description: Free choice: a typical faerie increasing Pretenses two seasons per year.

name: Ostentatious
description: Major General Virtue: the faerie gains Pretense every season; multiplier 25.

name: Pretentious
description: Minor General Virtue: the faerie increases Pretense three seasons per year; multiplier 20.

name: Highly Cognizant
description: Virtue marking a faerie that understands it can use human vitality to tailor its role.

name: Narrowly Cognizant
description: Cognizance level where a faerie knows a certain goal will bring contentment.

name: Incognizant
description: Cognizance level where a faerie's goals are unrelated to becoming more powerful.

name: Cognizant Within Role
description: Cognizance Virtue possessed by the Lesser Nymph.

name: Greater Faerie Powers
description: Virtue granting spell levels of Greater Powers.

name: Lesser Faerie Powers
description: Minor Virtue granting 25 spell levels of Lesser Powers.

name: Personal Faerie Powers
description: Virtue granting 25 spell levels of personal powers.

name: Ritual Faerie Powers
description: Virtue granting ritual-level faerie powers.

name: Focus Faerie Powers
description: Virtue granting a Focus Power of 25 spell levels.

name: Improved Powers
description: Minor Virtue explaining intricacy points.

name: Increased Faerie Might
description: Virtue increasing Faerie Might.

name: Improved Characteristics
description: Virtue improving characteristics.

name: Huge
description: Size Virtue possessed by Lamashtu.

name: Large
description: Size Virtue possessed by Lamia.

name: Feast of the Dead
description: Virtue possessed by Lamashtu and the Ghula.

name: Improved Initiative
description: Virtue improving Initiative, e.g. Lamashtu's clawed hands.

name: Hybrid Form
description: Virtue for faeries of mixed form, like Lamia and gorgons.

name: Humanoid Faerie
description: Virtue for faeries of human shape.

name: Decreased Might
description: Flaw reducing Might, possessed by Kubu.

name: Intangible Flesh
description: Flaw possessed by Kubu.

name: Small Frame
description: Flaw possessed by gorgons and the Lesser Nymph.

name: Little
description: Flaw taken twice by the Toy Soldier.

name: Dependant
description: Flaw: the Toy Soldier depends on a child.

name: Infiltrator
description: Virtue letting the Ghula pose as a wealthy orphaned merchant's daughter.

name: External Vis
description: Flaw where a faerie's vis resides outside its body, e.g. in a trinket.

name: Human Form
description: Virtue possessed by the glanconer.

name: Non-combatant
description: Flaw of the glanconer.

name: Faerie Friend
description: Virtue giving a character a faerie friend, often toy-like or animal-shaped in childhood.

name: Skinchanger
description: Virtue a trapped faerie spouse might have.

name: Inspirational
description: Virtue granting bonus to faerie advancement rolls.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue granting bonus to faerie advancement rolls and retelling stories.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability used to understand faerie motivations and treat Pine Away.

name: Animal Handling
description: Ability for caring for animal-form beings.

name: Animal Ken
description: Supernatural Ability allowing communication with animals and animal-form faeries.

name: Folk Ken
description: Understanding of human beings.

name: Bargain
description: Social Ability usable with any intelligent being.

name: Carouse
description: Social Ability.

name: Charm
description: Social Ability.

name: Etiquette
description: Social Ability.

name: Guile
description: Deception Ability, used as Pretense.

name: Intrigue
description: Social Ability.

name: Leadership
description: Social Ability.

name: Teaching
description: Ability; faeries cannot be taught.

name: Athletics
description: Physical Ability used for flight maneuvers.

name: Brawl
description: Unarmed combat Ability.

name: Medicine
description: Ability usable to treat Pine Away.

name: Awareness
description: Perception Ability.

name: Stealth
description: Ability to move unseen.

name: Music
description: Performance Ability.

name: Single Weapon
description: Combat Ability used by the Toy Soldier.

name: Finesse
description: Ability used to see through illusions.

name: Corpus
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Imaginem
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Mentem
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Ignem
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Aquam
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Animal
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Vim
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Terram
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Herbam
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Creo
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Intellego
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Muto
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Rego
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Perdo
description: Hermetic Art referenced as a Form/Technique for faerie powers.

name: Circle of Beast Warding
description: Spell on which Repel Animals is based.

name: Clouds of Summer Snow
description: Spell compared to Spreading a Mantle of Snow.

name: Curse of the Desert
description: Spell on which Torrent from the Lungs is based.

name: Disguise of the Transformed Image
description: Spell used as basis for an impersonation power.

name: Donning the Mask of Another
description: Ritual from House of Hermes: Societates duplicating an individual's memories.

name: Ambush on the Deserted Road
description: Spell for selective invisibility.

name: Veil of Invisibility
description: Spell on which the Invisibility power is based.

name: Treading the Ashen Path
description: PeHe 30 spell used as basis for Fatal Menses.

name: Coils of Entangling Plants
description: Herbam spell underlying the nymph power.

name: Image Phantom (spell)
description: Imaginem spell on which the Image Phantom power is based.

name: Faerie Realm
description: The realm of faeries.

name: Dominion
description: Divine realm within which some faeries travel.

name: Divine
description: Realm that casts down faeries grown too powerful.

name: Infernal
description: Realm whose edges faerie horrors lie at.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm associated with primordial cyclopes.

name: Arcadia
description: Faerie otherworld where humans who eat faerie food are trapped.

name: Deep Arcadia
description: Where faeries grown mighty enough go and are lost.

name: Corinth
description: Site of an ancient shrine to Lamia and of Apollonios's wedding confrontation.

name: Libya
description: Land whose queen became Lamia.

name: Babylon
description: Ancient land whose faerie gods rivaled Lamashtu.

name: Greece
description: Home of lamiae, gorgons and cyclopes.

name: Yorkshire
description: Home of the Grindylow.

name: Wales
description: Home of the Morgan.

name: Ireland
description: Home of the Pontarf and Coinchenn.

name: Scotland
description: Home of the Lammikin.

name: Bohemia
description: Home of the Jezinkas.

name: Asturia
description: Where the Dragon-Maiden lives in a cave.

name: Hades
description: Classical afterlife likened to eternal life without events.

name: Hell
description: To which faeries tithe souls in some beliefs.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting.

name: Lamashtu
description: Ancient Babylonian goddess of stillbirth, a Might 45 faerie with lion head, donkey teeth and owl feet.

name: Lamia
description: Former queen of Libya, cursed by Hera, now a serpent-bodied faerie who eats children and steals eyes.

name: Lamiae
description: Lesser Greek faeries with goat or snake bodies that eat babies and drink blood.

name: Kubu
description: Infant-sized faerie, a child who died unnamed, who lures children away to die.

name: The Man in Black with a Sack on His Back
description: Scarecrow-bodied faerie that steals naughty children in a sack.

name: Changeling
description: Withered faerie exchanged for a mortal baby to be rejuvenated by a mother's nurture.

name: Black Terrors
description: Weakest faeries observed: dark shapes on children's walls with 1 Might.

name: Cyclopes
description: Cannibalistic one-eyed giants used as Greek nursery terrors.

name: Licho
description: A kind of cyclops used as a Slavic nursery terror.

name: Jenny Greenteeth
description: Nursery terror who drags children into wells.

name: Grindylow
description: Yorkshire variant of Jenny Greenteeth inhabiting pools and marshes.

name: Nellie Long Arms
description: Variant of Jenny Greenteeth with long arms.

name: Morgan
description: Welsh freshwater merman nursery terror.

name: Pontarf
description: Irish giant fish nursery terror.

name: Lammikin
description: Ugly Scottish faerie who torments children and kills mothers.

name: Gorgon
description: Nursery terror faerie with snake hair, tusks, brass claws and a petrifying gaze.

name: Medusa
description: Gorgon whose name means protector.

name: Mormo
description: Possessing faerie that bites naughty children, once a mother turned werewolf.

name: The Tortoise
description: Faerie that possesses mothers to kill their babies; Mormo's role mate.

name: Faerie Godmothers
description: Protector faeries who guard and gift godchildren.

name: Imaginary Friends
description: Toy-like faerie friends of children.

name: Toy Soldier
description: Foot-tall wooden faerie soldier guarding a sleeping child.

name: Faerie Animal Companions
description: Animal-shaped faeries who take children on adventures.

name: Guides to Adventure
description: Child-stealing faeries who take children on dangerous stories.

name: Nymphs
description: Beautiful faeries living at the edge of domesticated land who entrap lovers.

name: Lesser Nymph
description: Weak dancing nymph with Might 10.

name: Satyrs
description: Allies a nymph can summon.

name: Jezinkas
description: Bohemian faeries who steal eyes after lulling men to sleep.

name: Ghula
description: Faeries who marry and eat husbands, draining their blood.

name: Ghaddar
description: Ghula form who entices and paralyzes men.

name: Glanconer
description: Handsome male faerie who courts girls until they pine to death.

name: Kelpies
description: Faerie horses that drown victims.

name: Selkies
description: Faeries made into wives by theft of their sealskin.

name: Bird Women
description: Faeries forced to be spouses when their feather cloaks are stolen.

name: Coinchenn
description: Dog-headed Irish giantess who beheads her daughter's suitors.

name: The Dragon-Maiden
description: Asturian girl turned into a cuelebre by a nymph.

name: Cuelebre
description: A sort of dragon.

name: Child Killers
description: Common faeries of folklore that kill children.

name: Child Stealers
description: Faeries that steal children.

name: Nursery Terrors
description: Faeries that terrify children.

name: Doppelganger
description: German faerie appearing as a person's duplicate.

name: Faun
description: Faerie that steals infants to the forest.

name: Faerie Knight
description: Faerie knight with Pretenses.

name: Courtly Faeries
description: Statistical template for powerful faeries.

name: Pazuzu
description: Babylonian disease spirit whose image Lamashtu fears.

name: Giants
description: Guards of perfect spouses.

name: Neil
description: Example player who designs a doppelganger faerie.

name: Dave
description: Example player with faerie knight.

name: Zeus
description: God who loved Lamia.

name: Hera
description: Goddess who cursed Lamia.

name: Scylla
description: Lamia's surviving child.

name: Perseus
description: Hero who used the gorgon's head.

name: Errina
description: Ancient Greek writer who described the tortoise game.

name: Lady of the Lake
description: Captured Merlin.

name: Merlin
description: Captured by the Lady of the Lake.

name: Triamore
description: Faerie lover who silences a knight.

name: True Thomas
description: Struck dumb by the faerie queen.

name: Calypso
description: Offered Odysseus eternal domestic bliss.

name: Odysseus
description: Hero tempted by Calypso.

name: Sir Degare
description: Hero of a lai left gloves and a sword.

name: Sir Gawain
description: Hero of Sir Gawain and the Green Knight.

name: Philostratus
description: Recorded Apollonios's conflict with a ghula.

name: Apollonios of Tyana
description: Ancient magician who confronted a ghula in Corinth.

name: Rapunzel
description: Story using a witch.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The magical order.

name: Church
description: Protects life stages with sacraments.

name: Magical Gloves and Sword of Degare
description: Gloves and broken-pointed sword left by Degare's faerie father.

name: Seal Skin
description: Skin whose theft binds a selkie wife.
